narr: A cluster of thunderstorms developed along a weakening frontal boundary in the Upstate. The storms held together into the central Midlands, causing flash flooding in the north central Midlands.
ev: Fairfield County Dispatch reported flash flooding causing cars to stall at the intersection of Old Camden Rd and Columbia Rd.
Trained spotter in Lancaster reported flash flooding at N Main St and Woodland Dr covering the road up to the tires on cars.
